text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (My legs... they won't stretch out...! Is this where it ends, my—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, Daiichi Ruby lost!
I guess she couldn't avenge her mother after all.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, just throwing this out there, but...
Isn't 2,400m... a bit too long for Daiichi Ruby?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "No, no! Her mother won a 2400m GⅠ, so she'll be fine too!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Let's look forward to a comeback from here!
After all, she's from the "Illustrious Clan"!
(Waaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(I see.
After all, I am—)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—I deeply apologize
for showing you such a pathetic display.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "Trainer also helped us out for today by designing the menu and more."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I feel utterly ashamed
that I failed to live up to your support.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

On the surface, Daiichi Ruby seemed perfectly calm.
Yet there was no telling how she felt deep down.
As for myself—I felt nothing but frustration.
choice_data_list: Next time... I'll be of use to you.
Next time... I will be of use to you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Our next target race is the Shuka Sho as planned...
However, before that, I have a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Rather than heading straight there,
we'll enter the prep race, the 'Rose Stakes', in between.

The "Rose Stakes"... A race chosen by many Umamusume as a prep race for the "Shuka Sho."
They compete over a distance of 1800m.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
We also have summer camp, so we will need
to ensure she peaks in time for her target race.

Tracen Academy holds a summer training camp
where the Umamusume work hard to improve their abilities.
Indeed, rather than taking a long break afterwards, squeezing in one race would probably help keep her body in racing shape.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's move on to the Rose Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.
choice_data_list: Alright, I'll be waiting at the entrance.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Understood.

"Watching today's race convinced me.
Daiichi Ruby is—"
choice_data_list: (She's a girl who shines brightest in sprints.)

text_block_list.text:
"Judging by her frustrating run and intense fatigue,
there is no doubt. The speed she showed in the
Fillies' Revue is her true forteâ"

And she understands that full well herself.
Even so, she has no intention of abandoning the royal road.
As her Trainer... what should I do?

"The Shuka Sho is 2,000 meters—a distance
like that might just be manageable.
I'll have to think it over while training at summer camp—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting.
Let us head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(—There is no longer any doubt
that my aptitude lies in sprints.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (There are wonderful Umamusume in the sprints, too, achieving glorious results. But...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: This is not "my" path—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(All I seek is the royal road.
A brilliant, magnificent path...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Prestigious races like the Tenno Sho, or high-profile
Grand Prix races like the Arima Kinen...
The path I ought to walk is set, and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (To think straying from that path would be the "right" path for "me"...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I wonder...
what Mother would say.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's too early to make a decision.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Overcome the distance issue at summer camp,
and first take on the Rose Stakes.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (For my mission, I will do everything that must be done—)

"—The much-watched 'Noble Scion,'
Daiichi Ruby, was unfortunately unable
to claim her redemption."

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: That running is...

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Ruby.
That girl is truly our—
